name: mix
description: Mixed-API workload: ONE total arrival rate, split across endpoints by the ratio table in src/mixed/trade-mix.js (placeholder ratios pending the production traffic profile). Open model. RATE= overrides the TOTAL rate, DURATION= the window.
_pools: A mixed round consumes BOTH consumable pools: demand per pool = ratio x total rate x duration x 1.2 (preflight-enforced). Default 10 req/s x 10m needs ~1080 update-ids and ~1080 approve-tasks; size trial runs down with RATE=4 DURATION=1m.
_override: Command-line overrides apply to the scalar keys of this single template scenario BEFORE the per-endpoint split, so RATE= scales the whole mix proportionally.

thresholds._circuitBreaker: Two-tier lines, same rationale as load.json: strict line is the verdict, lenient line + abortOnFail is the shared-environment breaker.
